answer: Proposal: summit-tier payouts draw from a fixed pool and weight each key by its squared locked stake, never by key count. A ledger ties every coin to one key for 40 epochs. A farm can forge keys with one model and borrow capital, but splitting S coins among k clones divides their combined weight by k; restoring it requires more distinct coins immobilized, a spiral of financing costs even on loan. Proposed validators reject reused locks; if a key signs a provably false grade, they slash its lock. An unlocked clone earns zero.
